source_states.SUPPORTED_BY_EXISTING_LINEAGE: Exact record references plus registered collection/build/adapter evidence support this limited observation scope; no claim of unmodified values or binary attestation.
source_states.CONDITIONAL_ASSUMPTION: A specific necessary collection or transformation premise remains unsupported.
source_states.UNRESOLVED: Necessary identity or collection-scope evidence is absent or unreadable.
source_states.CONFLICT: Explicit record identities, mappings, registered source metadata, or preserved inputs disagree.

input_states.COMPLETE: Necessary original values and legal explicit status/quality are retained with correct structural types. Known non-observed statuses remain unchanged and are reported separately.
input_states.MISSING: A necessary value, state, or raw observation member is absent.
input_states.LOSSY: An evidenced transformation has discarded required information and no precisely linked upstream recovery exists.
input_states.MALFORMED: Present containers, primitive types, or state/quality enums violate the declared input contract.

readiness_rules.READY: Source is SUPPORTED_BY_EXISTING_LINEAGE and input is COMPLETE with exact source/adapter transfer checks passing.
readiness_rules.CONDITIONAL: Input is COMPLETE but source is CONDITIONAL_ASSUMPTION; no effective SourceBinding is constructed.
readiness_rules.BLOCKED: All other combinations. Source and input axes plus multiple nonexclusive reasons remain visible.

rules: Resolve only authoritative supervised_ids by exact opaque_id, registered line reference, candidate_id and session_id. Never infer identity from filenames, time or value similarity.
Keep missing authoritative IDs in every mode denominator; report duplicate or malformed authority entries without substituting another population.
Read cache_lineage_ref to S02 input_manifest_ref; R04 features are already computed atoms and must never masquerade as raw fields.
Compare each retained field only with its own upstream version for value/type/order preservation; never compare language against languages[0], normalize language tags, or compute candidate states.
Raw collection_status is explicit; S02 field_quality is derived by the registered adapter. Preserve the stored S02 status/quality without pretending quality was raw-collected.
A strict boolean webdriver false is valid legacy input, not an exclusion. Do not infer raw false, existence, typeof or realm from it.

Source checks use only exact references, collection/build metadata and registered code evidence. Labels, phase, tools, interventions and prediction outputs never enter these decisions or transferred payloads.
Construct SourceBinding only for a supported registered mode, with existing evidence references and exact source-group membership. Unknown or conditional sources never get an effective binding.
Raw observation absence is independent of legacy availability. No reconstruction or JS execution is permitted.
Freeze record decisions before joining existing phase/config/environment metadata for descriptive coverage strata. These already exposed materials do not regain blinded status.
permitted_execution: Read-only identity/structure/source audit and in-memory type/value/status-preserving projection; synthetic tests separately.
output_policy: Default complete JSON to stdout; explicit output directory exclusively creates INPUT_MANIFEST.jsonl and SUMMARY.json, refusing existing targets.
limits: No TPR/FPR/accuracy or new decision coverage
No cryptographic or binary equivalence claim
